_meta.description: Recruit the sorcery trainer from the room before the Crystal Sage (requires 10 INT), then keep him at Firelink by handing him at least one scroll before ~6 further boss kills. Scrolls unlock sorceries; buying 3 sorceries + 1 scroll as a non-sorcerer class earns the Young Dragon Ring. Late-game he intersects Yuria of Londor's questline.
_meta.mined_from: FightinCowboy 100% walkthrough eps 10, 14-16 (2026-07-05): recruit attempt failed at 8 INT — confirms the 10 INT gate; both scrolls picked up in Farron Keep.

evaluation.rule: Phases are evaluated top-to-bottom. First matching phase is current. Fallback phase always matches.
evaluation.detection_gaps: No confirmed flags for 'Orbeck recruited' or 'scroll given'. Young Dragon Ring is the only durable inventory proxy that a scroll was handed over (ring requires 3 sorceries bought + 1 scroll given + non-sorcerer class). Recruitment state is not detectable; phases lean on scroll possession, boss flags and bonfire area. EMEVD NPC state range for Orbeck is 1180-1199 — controlled saves needed to label.

first_third_scrolls.note: Both obtainable in Farron Keep, before the Abyss Watchers. Either one is enough to stop Orbeck from leaving.

later_scrolls.note: Logan's Scroll (Profaned Capital court sorcerer) and Crystal Scroll (Grand Archives) come much later.

orbeck_recruited.how_to_confirm: Controlled save pair: talk to Orbeck with 10+ INT, rest, diff. EMEVD NPC range 1180-1199; expect a commons transition like Greirat's 1224->1225.

orbeck_scroll_given.how_to_confirm: Controlled save pair: give Sage's Scroll at Firelink, rest, diff. Expect a 74000xxx talk flag.

phases.label: Secured — Young Dragon Ring received (scroll delivered)
phases.detection_note: The Young Dragon Ring is only given after buying 3 sorceries AND handing over a scroll — holding it proves Orbeck is safe.
phases.status_message: Orbeck is settled at Firelink — the Young Dragon Ring confirms you've given him a scroll. He will not leave.
next_steps: Keep feeding him scrolls as you find them (Logan's Scroll in the Profaned Capital, Crystal Scroll in the Grand Archives) for more sorceries
If you pursue Yuria of Londor's questline, she will eventually ask you to 'deal with' Orbeck — you do NOT need to kill him; his ashes work after he dies naturally at the end of his own quest

phases.label: Scroll in hand — deliver it to Orbeck
phases.detection_note: Player holds an undelivered scroll. Cannot tell whether Orbeck was recruited; message covers both cases.
phases.status_message: You are carrying a sorcery scroll. Orbeck leaves forever if you defeat ~6 bosses after recruiting him without giving him any scroll — hand it over at Firelink Shrine next time you rest.
next_steps: If you haven't recruited Orbeck yet: he waits on the second floor of the flooded room before the Crystal Sage arena (needs 10 INT — the check happens only once)
Give him the scroll at Firelink Shrine (talk → Give Scroll)
Non-sorcerer classes: buy any 3 sorceries from him after giving a scroll and he gifts you the Young Dragon Ring

phases.label: DANGER — Abyss Watchers dead, no scroll delivered
phases.detection_note: Post-Watchers with no scroll in inventory and no ring proxy. Either the player never engaged Orbeck (harmless) or he is about to leave (urgent). Message covers both.
phases.status_message: The Abyss Watchers are down and no scroll has been delivered to Orbeck. If you recruited him, he is on the verge of leaving Firelink forever (he departs after ~6 boss kills without receiving a scroll).
next_steps: Fetch the Sage's Scroll (near the Keep Ruins bonfire) or Golden Scroll (swamp cave, by the Antiquated Set) in Farron Keep NOW and give one to Orbeck
If he already left, his sorceries are lost for this playthrough (and Yuria's optional sub-quest with his ashes cannot complete)

phases.label: Recruit window — Orbeck waits near the Crystal Sage
phases.detection_note: Player has reached the Road of Sacrifices area; no recruitment signal exists, so this fires until a scroll/ring appears.
phases.status_message: Orbeck of Vinheim hides on the second floor of the flooded room leading to the Crystal Sage. Talk to him with 10+ Intelligence to recruit your sorcery trainer (he only checks INT once).
next_steps: Below 10 INT? Level it to 10, or come back later with the Scholar Ring — but don't forget him
After recruiting: hand him ANY scroll before ~6 more boss kills or he leaves forever (both the Sage's Scroll and Golden Scroll are in Farron Keep)
Sorcery builds: he sells Great Soul Arrow, Spook, Aural Decoy and more as soon as he reaches Firelink

next_steps: When you reach the Road of Sacrifices, bring 10 Intelligence to recruit him

always_check_warnings.label: Scroll in inventory — Orbeck's clock is ticking
always_check_warnings.message: You are carrying a sorcery scroll and bosses keep falling. If Orbeck was recruited and never received a scroll, he leaves Firelink forever after ~6 boss kills. Give him the scroll the next time you're at Firelink Shrine.
